project.title: Clinical and environmental Fusarium species sequencing
project.description: Aims of this project are to investigate the epidemiology of invasive fusariosis and superficial fusariosis in Japan. To elucidate the infectious route and source of Fusarium infection, we analyzed environmental Fusarium species as well.
project.center_name: Medical mycology research center, Chiba University
